mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, reducing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active when the latest GDP data shows positive YoY growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when the latest YoY GDP growth (GDPC1) is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to quality and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in the latest available data.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy combined with weakening economic supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 3-month MA and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is forced to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only during high inflation periods.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in economic activity, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal activates when INDPRO falls below 100.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, a leading indicator of economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when HOUST falls below 1200.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% in the last month and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in the last month signals stagflation, increasing equity risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when both conditions are met.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly rise > 0.2% AND CPIAUCSL monthly rise > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE monthly rise > 0.2% and CPIAUCSL monthly rise > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) below 138000 thousand persons signals a deteriorating labor market, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when PAYEMS falls below 138000.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 138000.
